# Source: Provincetown

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Provincetown
- **Artist / culture:** Marsden Hartley (American, 1877–1943)
- **Date:** 1916
- **Style:** Modernism
- **Classification:** oil on panel
- **Department:** Arts of the Americas
- **AIC artwork ID:** 65920
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/65920
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/f534bce3-4746-cba6-6c46-c37a7c9199fb/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Cubism

## Extracted source palette

`#B89888, #D8C8C8, #686868, #282828, #888878, #484848, #785848, #D8A8A8`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#151515`
- `surface`: `#303030`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#B89888`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#785848`
- `surface_variant`: `#303030`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#555554`
- `error`: `#B89888`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `mono` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `12dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `17.17:1`, surface `12.41:1`
- Variant contrast: `12.41:1`
- Control contrast: `7.34:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
